end.summary: Linked harvest festivals with the time when crops are ready; 2 unaided correct attempts.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised connecting harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready and noticing that festivals vary by region. They named foods and traditions for Diwali, Pongal, Makar Sankranti, and Baisakhi. There was initial uncertainty about the season-crop connection, then they linked Pongal in January with the arrival of the new rice crop. At home, ask Kavya to match one harvest festival with its crop, season, and regional tradition.
